scope: Adaptive descriptive development diagnostic; no new generation, no independent confirmation
feature: mean_token_entropy of previously selected baseline candidate; high values route
fold_rule: Sort task IDs by sha256(entropy-cv:20260923:{task_id}), assign rank modulo5; no label stratification
threshold_rule: For each training fold, among public-pass tasks with finite entropy, pick smallest of top ceil(0.20*n) entropies; route heldout public-pass if entropy>=threshold. Ties kept and actual rate reported. Missing entropy adds no trigger.
selection: Fixed fraction, no label-based threshold or fraction tuning
comparators: Public-only; public plus uniform random extra tasks in each heldout fold with exactly the entropy rule extra-trigger count.10000 repetitions,seed20260923.
metrics: Out-of-fold error TP/FP/FN/TN, recall, precision, added trigger cost, missing entropy; random comparator distribution; descriptive entropy-length correlation and AUROC among public-pass only
claim_limit: Detection improvement is not correct-answer rescue. No best fraction/model search, no significance claim, no confirmation/reserve labels used.
